revisions.name: $th_sse_mr
revisions.reason: Legacy SSE reshape review: MOVD/MOVSD use existing per-thread XMM slices and width-specific guest access. CVTDQ2PS rejects misaligned m128 before reading/writing XMM, records fault address and actual instruction EIP (block start + decoded offset), then delegates to existing guest SEH and returns without dispatch. No new callback continuation/frame or state lifetime. Existing MOVNTPS fault path unchanged; general invocation ownership remains pending.
